set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the hostname of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The hostname of the device, used to identify the device in the network.

set protocols ldp.explanation: Enable the Label Distribution Protocol (LDP) on the device.

set protocols ldp router-id 1.1.1.9.explanation: Configure the router ID for LDP.

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: The router ID used by LDP, typically an IPv4 address.

set protocols ldp targeted-session 3.3.3.explanation: Configure a targeted LDP session with a remote peer.

parameters.name: peer-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address of the remote peer for the targeted LDP session.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 vlan-tagging.explanation: Enable VLAN tagging on the specified interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, such as ge-0/0/0.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 encapsula.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 encapsulation vlan-id 10
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 encapsula.explanation: Configure VLAN encapsulation for a logical unit on an interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, such as ge-0/0/0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The logical unit number.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: The VLAN ID for encapsulation.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family ethernet-switching
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.explanation: Enable Ethernet switching family on a logical unit of an interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, such as ge-0/0/0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The logical unit number.

set routing-instances a2 interface ge-0/.explanation: Assign an interface to a routing instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: The name of the routing instance.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface to be assigned, including the unit number.

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.10.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure the IPv4 address and subnet mask of the interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface names, such as ge-1/0/0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The interface unit number is used to distinguish multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of bits of the IPv4 subnet mask.

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mp.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mpls
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mp.explanation: Enable MPLS family on a logical unit of an interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, such as ge-1/0/0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The logical unit number.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface on which RSVP is enabled, including the unit number.

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.9/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: Configure the IPv4 address and subnet mask of the loopback interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface names, such as lo0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The interface unit number is used to distinguish multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the loopback interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of bits of the IPv4 subnet mask.

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.template: set protocols ospf area [parameter1] interface [parameter2] passive
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0 passive
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: Configure an OSPF interface as passive in a specified area.

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: The OSPF area identifier.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface to be configured as passive, including the unit number.

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-1/0/0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: Include an interface in an OSPF area.

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: The OSPF area identifier.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface to be included in the OSPF area, including the unit number.
